nodes.name: Graph Utilities
nodes.description: Graph preprocessing and scheduling utilities from KDD 2020 graph-learning solutions

nodes.name: node_degree_bucketing
nodes.description: Map node degrees to log-spaced integer buckets to reduce sensitivity to hubs
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes node degrees from edge index list of size E and bins N nodes into degree buckets.

nodes.name: feature_clip_standardize
nodes.description: Standardize features column-wise and clip extreme values to a bounded range
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes mean, standard deviation, clips, and standardizes N x D node features in linear time and space.

nodes.name: time_budget_estimator
nodes.description: Estimate remaining wall-clock budget and choose the largest feasible model complexity
nodes.type_signature: (elapsed_seconds: float, total_budget: float, model_complexities: NDArray[np.float64]) -> int
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Estimates required runtime by checking dynamic step patterns in linear time over N node items.

nodes.name: adjacency_smoothing
nodes.description: Apply symmetric degree normalization to an adjacency matrix
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Performs neighborhood feature aggregation by summing D-dimensional features of N nodes across E edges.
